invariants.rule: Workflow transactions, claims, scheduling, capabilities, completion and recovery have one implementation in workflow_core. Observers and adapters never write its tables.
Import and qualify the donor unchanged before introducing new semantics. Preserve the old executable and state-format baseline for differential checks.
cpp-context-compiler remains standalone. Project Control consumes a versioned pure read contract; no implicit refresh, rewrite or reverse workflow-product dependency.
Keep existing .todo-orchestrator paths, UUIDs and durable history during this program. Do not initialize replacement authorities.
Git/source, engine observations, executor state and host resources remain distinct authorities. Receipts identify evidence rather than manufacture truth.
Initial native v3 inputs contain only supported fields. Profiles remain sidecars until strict support is qualified; old reapplication must not erase profiles.
Difficulty/risk/context are task requirements, not scheduling priority, authorization or model names. Record actual executor facts separately.
Do not reset, force-push, automatically delete unknown work, or clean unrelated worktrees. Integrate and qualify owned commits before cleanup.
Missing tests, empty inventories, skips, stale records, fabricated done flags and rehearse-only deployments cannot qualify implementation.
Do not mutate the deployed runtime running this epic until a qualified candidate, writer fencing, backups and tested rollback/migrate-forward exist.
Budget the full response, preserve mandatory identity/coverage/security warnings and provide exact expansion routes. Smaller output is not license to hide contradictory evidence.
Package extraction, native import, controller launch, external configuration changes and actual deployment are distinct actions. This artifact performs none automatically.
